finding: startup failure closes storage before active seed execution drains
resolution: Bounded drainRuns before store.close in startup-error cleanup; preserve original error or both errors in AggregateError.
changes_after_followup: Startup failure regression uses isolated memory SQLite rather than full demo generation in Postgres; normal test runtime now uses actual 10000 ms product grace period. Runtime code is unchanged after follow-up; backend tests passed.
limitations: Forced stop cannot establish durable recovery; milestone 3 retains that work.
No real IdP, model provider, external deployment or Postgres outage drill was exercised.
